title: Toward a Holistic Evaluation of Robustness in CLIP Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions using cue-conflict stimuli datasets (e.g., Stylized-ImageNet) to assess the proportion of correct classifications that are based on an object's shape rather than its texture or other features.

Testing models on cue-conflict stimuli and measuring accuracy on Stylized-ImageNet to determine if certain fine-tuning strategies or larger input resolutions cause the model to rely more heavily on texture rather than shape.
